authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full taila gives widespread tel/tēl oil, Oriya tela and northwestern reflexes. This supports telo, Dang ṭʲal and both Bshk tel/tāīl alternatives, preserving local vowels/palatalization with transmission qualified. Exact response: ṭʲal.

proposals.evidence: Full lavaṇa gives Pali/Prakrit lavaṇa/lōṇa/lūṇa and the regional l/n-initial salt series, including Kalasha lṽŕ, Shina lōəṇ/lūəṇī, Bengali lon/lun/nūn and Marathi loṇ. These support retained lobon, reduced nasal-vowel forms, nwan/nʷãn/nõən and naṇ. Nasal loss or assimilation and local vowels remain qualified; both lobon/nun alternatives belong to this family. Cross-IA transmission is unresolved, not grounds for withholding the family link. Exact response: nʷãn.
